finding: In women with chronic hypertension and normal weight or overweight, moderate gestational weight gain may confer the lowest risk of adverse outcomes, while in women with chronic hypertension and obesity, low gestational weight gain may be necessary for the lowest risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: In women with chronic hypertension, low gestational weight gain in those with obesity and high gestational weight gain in those with normal weight or overweight was associated with increased risk of cesarean delivery.
